div.div: 5 تجهّز He fitted out, equipped, furnished, or supplied, himself; or he or it became fitted out or equipped or furnished or supplied; with his or its جَهَاز [or requisites, &c.]: (K:) he prepared himself. (S, K.) You say, تَجَهَّزْتُ لِأَمْرِ كَذَا, (S, K, *) and ↓ اِجْهَازَزْتُ , (K,) I prepared myself for such a thing. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
